decisions.reason: As a recent extension of the core coolant-management line that remained on the website after the first portfolio review, it still offers option value with relatively low incremental commercialization cost.

This centrifuge fits the firm's established process-media offering and, since it survived while some other 2023 launches were already removed, management would likely keep it while demand continues to resolve.

The scraper belt chip conveyor is close to the firm's automation and material-flow base, and its continued presence suggests acceptable prospects, though portfolio breadth makes conveyor variants somewhat more exposed to later pruning.

The hinged belt chip conveyor still has value as a complementary option in the chip-handling range, but because the firm already has a broad product portfolio and has pruned adjacent variants, its discontinuation risk is slightly higher than the stronger core additions.
